paragraphs.source_en: If I were a snowflake, fluttering freely and gracefully in midair, I would surely know my direction clearly-- flying, flying, flying-- upon this earth there is my direction. I will not go to that cold and lonely hidden valley, nor to that desolate, mournful mountainside, nor will I drift onto a deserted street to brood-- flying, flying, flying-- look, I have my direction! In midair I will dance with tender grace, having recognized that quiet, secluded dwelling, waiting for her to come into the garden to visit-- flying, flying, flying-- ah, on her body is the clear fragrance of cinnabar plum blossoms! Then, relying on the lightness of my body, delicately, I will cling to the lapel of her dress, press close to her heart, soft as rippling waves-- melting, melting, melting-- melting into her heart, soft as rippling waves!

units.source_en: If I were a snowflake, fluttering freely and gracefully in midair, I would surely know my direction clearly-- flying, flying, flying-- upon this earth there is my direction.

ja.t: でひらひらと、のびやかに

units.source_zh:
假如我是一朵雪花，

翩翩的在半空裏瀟灑，

我一定認清我的方向——

飛揚，飛揚，飛揚——

這地面上有我的方向。

units.source_en: I will not go to that cold and lonely hidden valley, nor to that desolate, mournful mountainside, nor will I drift onto a deserted street to brood-- flying, flying, flying-- look, I have my direction!
units.source_zh:
不去那冷寞的幽谷，

不去那悽清的山麓，

也不上荒街去惆悵——

飛揚，飛揚，飛揚——

你看，我有我的方向！

units.source_en: In midair I will dance with tender grace, having recognized that quiet, secluded dwelling, waiting for her to come into the garden to visit-- flying, flying, flying-- ah, on her body is the clear fragrance of cinnabar plum blossoms!
units.source_zh:
在半空裏娟娟地飛舞，

認明瞭那清幽的住處，

等着她來花園裏探望——

飛揚，飛揚，飛揚——

啊，她身上有硃砂梅的清香！

units.source_en: Then, relying on the lightness of my body, delicately, I will cling to the lapel of her dress, press close to her heart, soft as rippling waves-- melting, melting, melting-- melting into her heart, soft as rippling waves!
units.source_zh:
那時我憑藉我的身輕，

盈盈地，沾住了她的衣襟，

貼近她柔波似的心胸——

消溶，消溶，消溶——

溶入了她柔波似的心胸！
